type: Verification through reasonable means that the consumer entitled to exercise consumer rights is the same consumer exercising them with respect to the personal data at issue (§ 59.1-575, "authenticate")
Commercially reasonable authentication efforts; where unsuccessful the controller need not comply and may request additional information reasonably necessary to authenticate (§ 59.1-577(B)(4))
Use of an existing account; a controller shall not require a consumer to create a new account to exercise consumer rights but may require use of an existing account (§ 59.1-578(E))
